parsed.summary: The netlist implements the specified architecture with the expected connectivity and values: TPS2121 power mux, AP63203 buck, TPS1H200 heater high-side switch, three MAX31855 SPI thermocouple channels, two protected fan tach inputs, USB-C/12 V inputs, WS2812B, and heater status LED. Reference-designator changes and the documented limitations are not anomalies, and no file-supported electrical deviation was found.
